title: Historic structures.
officialText:
The Board of Standards and Appeals is authorized to issue a variance for the repair or rehabilitation of a historic structure provided that:
1. The application has received approval from the Landmark Preservation Commission and/or the New York State Historical Preservation Office, as applicable;
2. The proposed repair or rehabilitation will not preclude the structure's continued designation as a historic structure; and
3. The variance is the minimum necessary to preserve the historic character and design of the structure.
